zh-CN.title: 聊天媒体更稳定
items: 改善刚上传图片与视频的预览衔接，遇到临时加载或缓存问题时自动恢复
图片与视频统一按比例控制气泡尺寸，减少上传确认前后的尺寸跳动

en.title: More reliable chat media
items: New uploads keep a working preview and recover automatically from temporary loading or cache failures
Photos and videos share proportional thumbnail limits with steadier sizing across upload confirmation
